PreToolUse.command: node -e "const f=(JSON.parse(process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT||'{}')).file_path||'';if(/\/CLAUDE\.md$|\/\.claude\/settings\.json$|\/mcp_servers/.test(f)){process.stderr.write('BLOCK: '+f+' is a governance file. Do not edit without explicit user request.');process.exit(2)}"
PreToolUse.description: Protect CLAUDE.md, settings.json, and MCP configs from accidental edits

Stop.description: Run Mimic test suite after each response
